pccs_url.description: PCCS server address for quote verification collateral and PCK certificate retrieval.

use_secure_cert.description: Whether to accept insecure HTTPS certificates. Set to false to allow self-signed or invalid certs.

collateral_service.description: Alternative PCCS or Intel PCS service URL for retrieving quote verification collateral. If empty, uses pccs_url.

tcb_update_type.description: Type of TCB Info update: 'standard' for normal access or 'early' for early access during recovery events.

pccs_api_version.description: PCCS API version to use (3.0 or 3.1). Ignored if collateral_service is Intel PCS.

retry_times.description: Maximum retry times for QCNL. Set to 0 to disable retries.

retry_delay.description: Seconds to sleep before each retry when a transfer fails with a transient error.

local_pck_url.description: Local URL to retrieve PCK cert chain from first. If empty, fails over to pccs_url.

pck_cache_expire_hours.description: Hours before PCK cache entries expire. Set to 0 to disable caching.

verify_collateral_cache_expire_hours.description: Hours before quote verification collateral cache entries expire.

local_cache_only.description: If true, exclusively use PCK certificates from local cache files and do not request from providers.
